## PASTA 1.2.3

First PASTA release.

### Loader

- The loader now uses the Astral-derived D3D11/DirectComposition interface with PASTA branding and a red palette.
- The title bar's sparkles are animated pasta noodles, and the success screen draws a checkmark before closing automatically.
- A second loader launch focuses the existing window and exits instead of starting another session.
- The loader requests administrator rights, starts Steam and Counter-Strike 2 when needed, then launches `vesta.exe` from the same folder.

### PASTA

- External, read-only Counter-Strike 2 assist: no injection and no driver.
- PASTA adds dedicated Automation and Walk Bot pages with Auto Crouch, Auto Health Shot, Auto Knife, Auto Scope, Auto Bonus Weapon, rear defense and spray controls.
- Visuals, aimbot/RCS, triggerbot, Auto Stop, radar, configs and localization remain available.
- Lua/Web Radar, grenade helpers and Bunny Hop/Edge Jump are removed to reduce maintenance after game updates.

### Downloads

Download both files and keep them together in the same folder:

- `pasta_loader.exe` — recommended launcher. Approve the UAC prompt, then press **Load PASTA**.
- `vesta.exe` — the assist itself. Start it this way if Counter-Strike 2 is already running.

PASTA makes no anti-cheat guarantee. Use it at your own risk.
